source_audit_support.source_locator: SPP Document 208, Section 11 copyright and ownership

proposed.explanation: Under SPP 208, copyright is retained by the Author (the architect who created the design). The winning design may be executed only once — the Owner receives the right to build the design one time. Additional uses require separate negotiation.
